objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, translated, invalidated, reactivated, and displayed in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document name includes document type abbreviation, consecutive number per type, and title by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title component of the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Document metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document metadata and lifecycle/workflow state that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Document metadata that can be automatically printed in the document.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to Master Data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Document property maintained to link documents to IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Document property maintained via document properties.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Document property used to assign reader User Groups.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Document property used to assign the registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Document property used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Document property used to assign reviewers.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Document property used to assign releasers.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity period starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type and used to calculate the valid until date.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: original_language
attributes.description: Language of the original version before translation.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type for archived documents.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a new document; document templates, validity periods, and archive duration can be defined per document type.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in document names by default.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive four-digit number assigned per document type.

objs.name: document_level
objs.description: Level used to differentiate documents for structuring and evaluation options.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: ms_office_format
objs.description: Standard format used to generate new documents, such as Excel, Word, or PowerPoint.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific information maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the main document and subject to versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created and managed for a document without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity extension must be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate invalidated documents.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating in authoring, reviewing, releasing, translating, acknowledging, reading, or initiating document-related workflows.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION for providing functions to individual users.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users assigned for authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access, or administration.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to User Groups or persons for documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, AKS, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement processes.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for released versions.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, document releases, change proposals, validity extension, AKS, and acknowledgements.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by persons or users of assigned User Groups that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document assigning User Groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked in database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked in database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked in database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked in database integration.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Example of Master Data with which documents can be linked.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document that must be checked and released with workflow support.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Context in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view listing documents relevant to a user based on distribution assignments.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selection of a document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Select the corresponding document type when creating a new document.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select a defined document template when creating a new document object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading external files or documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific metadata and control information in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain metadata for a document in categories.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using an implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_document
evts.description: Display the current PDF version of the document on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to the content of a document.

evts.name: change_document_property
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when released documents are changed or revised.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process via the Control (release) category.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_information
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment associated with a document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers approve and release a document.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject during review or release, causing workflow cancellation for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: System informs involved users about workflow status, tasks, document releases, change proposals, validity extension, AKS, and acknowledgements by e-mail.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participants complete their assigned tasks.

evts.name: apply_electronic_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, creating a new editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting document content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change proposal so that it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity for the document.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Delete the request for validity extension after additional validity is declared or a new version is released.

evts.name: update_valid_until_date
evts.description: Update the valid until date by the default value of three years.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised new version is released or when suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: Process a request for AKS with workflow support.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare documents and their attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive a document by withdrawing authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke authorizations at User Group and person level except for the archive group.

evts.name: delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Automatically start and process the reactivation workflow.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents by creating a new version and restoring authorizations and distribution list data.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate Attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for each document by assigning User Groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipients actively confirm acknowledgement of a document version without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team
evts.description: Notify the author team about outstanding acknowledgements and when all acknowledgements are confirmed.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups assigned per document.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Use role-specific evaluation reports and searches for documents in the system.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check a translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release a translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_document_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible in a multi-client system.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to make a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of the corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A document can be created from a selected template.
A pure object cover can be created for a document.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.
A document has standardized and customer-specific metadata.
Attributes and metadata are grouped in categories.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to each document and are associated with the main document version.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Users can be assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient for documents.
User Groups can be assigned to documents for reader access, authorizations, and distribution.
Users are assigned to User Groups.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Read and change rights can be assigned to a group of users for each document.
Personal authorizations are assigned for author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser.
Workflow tasks are completed by workflow participants.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version and can be printed as document content.
Users involved are informed by e-mail notifications.
Acknowledgements are documented and summarized for authors or other key roles of the document.
Persons and users of assigned User Groups confirm acknowledgement.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning User Groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents in the system can be automatically linked with Master Data.
IT applications are given as an example of Master Data.
Documents can be linked with other documents and local documents can reference original documents.
A document can have a translated language version.
For each document in a multi-client system, visibility in clients can be specified.
Documents relevant to a user are listed in the dashboard.
User-specific dashboards are filled based on distribution assignments.
Reports provide evaluations of documents stored in the system.

Document is created using the selected template.
External file is uploaded to object cover.
MS Office format is used for generation.
Saved document is converted to PDF.
New editing version is created for the document.
Authorization is assigned for the document.
Workflow participants are assigned for the document.
User is assigned as workflow participant.
Additional information is added to document.
Author decides to add additional information.
Author decides to add an Attachment.
Archiving of Attachment affects associated main document version.
Approval process is initiated for document.
Author or co-author starts the process.
Creator step belongs to document release workflow.
Participant rejects during review or release.
Signature is documented for document version.
Author creates a new version when document needs revision.
Change proposal is created for document.
Employee with author rights creates Change proposal.
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Scheduling creates a new version of the document.
Author documents editing of assigned Change proposal.
Request for validity extension is created.
Request is created for document nearing validity expiry.
Releasers or release-process users carry out the check.
Additional validity is declared for document.
Request for AKS is created for selected document.
User with write access creates request for AKS.
Attachments are declared invalid with document.
User Group authorization is revoked except archive group.
Archived document is physically deleted after archive period.
Business Admin group is permitted to create request.
Creator of request is editor of workflow step.
Authorizations are set according to maintained attributes.
Distribution list is confirmed from invalidated version.
Attachment archived with document is reactivated.
Distribution list is maintained for document.
User Group is assigned to distribution.
Document release information is distributed by e-mail.
Assigned users are informed by e-mail.
Users of assigned User Groups are informed by e-mail.
Acknowledgement is requested for document upon release.
Persons and users of assigned User Groups are requested by e-mail.
Notification concerns outstanding or completed acknowledgements.
New local document is created in client.
Local document is created in client.
Reference is created to original document.
